title: Recovered names and corrections: Jim Conklin, Frank Comstock, Oasis personnel
summary: Lee supplies the Capitol president Jim Conklin and arranger Frank Comstock and denies Eric Dolphy or Wilfred Middlebrooks played in his Oasis band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you remember the name of the President of Capitol who was married to a King Sister?
No ... damn ...
I'll find it out somewhere.
Oh, okay. I almost called it. Go ahead, I'll get it yet.

You said that 2 of Kay Starr's hits were recorded there. Was "Wheel of Fortune" one of them? I was looking through some old Kay Starr records trying to figure out which one it was, and I can't remember which one of her hits ...
No, I don't think it was "Wheel of Fortune".
The man at Capitol? You found him?
Yeah, Jim Conklin. Jim Conklin was his name.
Uh huh. And the name of the man who arranged for your band at the Alabam who you said later became big in TV music?
Comstock. His name was Comstock. Now I'm not sure if it was Fred Comstock.
There's a Frank.
Frank Comstock, that's right. I knew it was a F. It was Frank Comstock, that's him.
Good. Okay. And he doesn't do arrangements for $10 any more?
Not any more. But I got them for $10.
Your band at the Oasis, you mentioned, had Ernie Freeman, Maxwell Davis and Charlie Mingus.
Yeah. And Par Jones.

And Par Jones. I looked up some research I did for the Black California liner notes in which I talked to Ernie Freeman, and he mentioned that your band had Wilfred Middlebrooks on bass sometimes, and Eric Dolphy on tenor, is that right?
No. I never had Eric Dolphy. Never worked for me.
Ernie remembered that ...

Well, at that time, Ernie's memory wasn't too good. I'll just tell you that right now. You know, some nights, Ernie didn't remember where he was, what stand he was on, so I'll have to go with me, on that.
All right, did Wilfred Middlebrooks play bass sometimes in your band?
No. Unh unh.
Okay. You mentioned something Lester said to you, and you said he called you 'Little Pea', was that his name for you?
Yeah, that was his nickname for me. Yeah. Uh huh.
